answer: Because the signal count is verified against the cedar text itself, the yarrow audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 44 aliases therefore means producing 44 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
